title: Me and My Family
parentNote: This unit covers family relationships, home, and basic personal information. Perfect for starting GK practice!
learnBullets: Know your **family members** and their relationships
Learn about **home** and things we use daily
learnItFirst:
**1. Family Members**

- **Father** (Papa/Dad) and **Mother** (Mummy/Mom) are your parents
- Your **parents' parents** are your grandparents (Dada-Dadi or Nana-Nani)
- Your **father's brother** is your uncle (Chacha/Tau)
- Your **mother's brother** is also your uncle (Mama)
- Your **uncle's or aunt's children** are your cousins

**2. Our Home**

- Kitchen is where we **cook food**
- Bedroom is where we **sleep**
- Bathroom is where we **take bath** and brush teeth
- Living room is where **family sits together**

**3. Important Information**

- Everyone should know their **full name**
- Know your **home address** and **phone number**
- Know your **parents' names**

questions.content: Your mother's mother is your ___.
questions.why: Your mother's mother (or father's mother) is your grandmother

questions.content: Your father's brother is your ___.
questions.why: Your father's brother is your uncle (Chacha or Tau)

questions.content: Where do we cook food at home?
questions.why: We cook food in the kitchen

questions.content: Your uncle's son is your ___.
questions.why: Your uncle's or aunt's children are your cousins

questions.content: Which room do we use to sleep?
questions.why: We sleep in the bedroom

questions.content: Your sister's daughter is your ___.
questions.why: Your brother's or sister's daughter is your niece

questions.content: Who cooks food for the family?
questions.why: Parents or a cook prepare food for the family at home

questions.content: Your mother's sister is your ___.
questions.why: Your mother's sister (or father's sister) is your aunt (Mausi or Bua)

questions.content: Where do we brush our teeth?
questions.why: We brush our teeth in the bathroom

questions.content: Your brother's son is your ___.
questions.why: Your brother's or sister's son is your nephew

questions.content: Riya's father's father is Riya's ___.
questions.why: Your father's father is your grandfather (Dada)

questions.content: Which of these is NOT a room in a house?
questions.why: Classroom is found in school, not in a house

questions.content: Amit's mother's brother is Amit's ___.
questions.why: Your mother's brother is your maternal uncle (Mama)

questions.content: We keep our clothes in a ___.
questions.why: We keep clothes in a wardrobe or cupboard

questions.content: Priya has a brother named Rohan. Priya is Rohan's ___.
questions.why: If Rohan is Priya's brother, then Priya is Rohan's sister

questions.content: Which appliance keeps food cold and fresh?
questions.why: A refrigerator (fridge) keeps food cold and fresh

questions.content: Ananya's aunt's son is Ananya's ___.
questions.why: Your aunt's children are your cousins

questions.content: Where should we eat our meals?
questions.why: We should eat our meals at the dining table with family

questions.content: A family that includes grandparents, parents, and children living together is called a ___ family.
questions.why: A joint or extended family has grandparents, parents, uncles, aunts, and children living together

questions.content: We should wash our hands ___.

options.B: Before eating and after using the toilet

questions.why: We must wash hands before eating and after using the toilet to stay healthy

questions.content: Raj's grandmother has a son. That son is Raj's ___.
questions.why: Your grandmother's son could be your father or your uncle

questions.content: Which of these should you know in case of emergency?

options.B: Your home address and parent's phone number

questions.why: Knowing your home address and parent's phone number helps in emergencies

questions.content: A family with only parents and their children is called a ___ family.
questions.why: A nuclear family has only parents and their children

questions.content: We use a ___ to wash dirty clothes.
questions.why: A washing machine is used to wash dirty clothes

questions.content: Neha's father's sister is Neha's ___.
questions.why: Your father's sister is your aunt (Bua)

sections.name: Achiever's Corner
sections.leadingContext: These questions are a bit tricky. Think carefully!

questions.content: Meera's mother's mother's son is Meera's ___.
questions.why: Mother's mother = Nani. Nani's son = Mother's brother = Mama (maternal uncle)

questions.content: In a photograph, Rahul sees a man. Rahul says, "This man's son is my father." Who is the man in the photo?
questions.why: If the man's son is Rahul's father, then the man is Rahul's grandfather

questions.content: Pointing to a lady, Riya says, "She is my mother's mother." Who is the lady?
questions.why: Mother's mother is your grandmother (Nani)

questions.content: Kavya introduces a boy saying, "He is the son of my father's only child." Who is the boy?
questions.why: Father's only child = Kavya herself. Son of Kavya = Kavya's son

questions.content: If your mother's sister's husband's daughter is your cousin, what is your mother's sister's husband to you?
questions.why: Your mother's sister's husband is your uncle (Mausa)
